app.name: Siteco Document Chat

app.greeting: Hello. What would you like to know today?

startup.startingHint: The search model is loading. This only takes a moment.
startup.unavailable: The server is not reachable right now.
startup.unavailableHint: Start the app with docker compose up, then try again.

banner.missingKey: No API key configured. Search and sources work, answers do not yet.
banner.missingKeyHint: Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the .env file and restart the app.

errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action is not possible here.
errors.SERVICE_STARTING: The app is still starting. One moment please.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than {max_mb} MB. Split it or use a smaller version.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: This format isn't supported. You can add PDF, TXT and Markdown files.
errors.FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The content doesn't match the file extension. Save it again as PDF, TXT or Markdown.
errors.EMPTY_FILE: This file is empty. Choose a different file.
errors.DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT: This file is already in your library.
errors.STORAGE_QUOTA: Your library reached its {max_mb} MB limit. Remove a document to make room.
errors.STORAGE_FULL: The disk is full. Free up some space or remove documents.
errors.UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The upload was interrupted. Please try again.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_READY: This document is still being processed. It'll be ready shortly.
errors.DOCUMENT_FILE_MISSING: The original file is gone. Please add the document again.
errors.DELETE_FAILED: Deleting didn't fully work. Try again, anything already removed stays removed.
errors.RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE: This part of the file doesn't exist. Reload the view.
errors.PDF_ENCRYPTED: This PDF is password protected. Save a copy without a password and add it again.
errors.PDF_CORRUPT: This PDF can't be opened and may be damaged. Export it again and retry.
errors.PDF_NO_TEXT: This PDF has no readable text, it's probably a scan. Text recognition isn't supported yet. Use a version with a text layer.
errors.PDF_TOO_MANY_PAGES: This PDF has more pages than the app can process. Split it into smaller files.
errors.TEXT_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: We can't read this file's text encoding. Save it as UTF-8 and add it again.
errors.DOCUMENT_EMPTY: We couldn't find any text in this file. Choose a file that contains text.
errors.DOCUMENT_TOO_LONG: This document is too long. Split it into smaller files.
errors.PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Processing took too long. Try again or split the file.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: Something went wrong while processing. Please try again.
errors.PROCESSING_INTERRUPTED: Processing was interrupted by a restart. Just start it again.
errors.MALWARE_DETECTED: The virus check found malware in this file. The file was deleted right away.
errors.MALWARE_SCAN_FAILED: The virus check could not check this file, so it was not added to be safe. Try again.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: The server is not reachable right now.
errors.FORBIDDEN_ORIGIN: This request did not come from the app and was blocked.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: No connection. Check your connection and try again.

notices.PAGES_WITHOUT_TEXT: {count, plural, one {# page has no text, probably scanned. It won't be searched.} other {# pages have no text, probably scanned. They won't be searched.}}
notices.PAGES_SKIPPED: {count, plural, one {# page couldn't be read and is missing from search.} other {# pages couldn't be read and are missing from search.}}
notices.PDF_ACTIVE_CONTENT: This PDF contains active content such as scripts. The app only reads the text and runs nothing.
notices.SCANNER_STARTING: The virus check is still starting. The file will be checked in a moment.
notices.SCANNER_UNAVAILABLE: The virus check is not reachable right now. The file waits until it is back.
